record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: Given a bounded region Q with connected boundary inside an asymptotically flat 3-manifold satisfying the positive mass theorem hypotheses, show that Q has an isometric extension by another such manifold that is static outside Q; further, determine whether the static extension has least ADM mass among horizon-free extensions outside Q.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a complete, asymptotically flat Riemannian 3-manifold of nonnegative scalar curvature satisfying the hypotheses of the positive mass theorem (so that the ADM mass is well-defined and nonnegative). Let $\Omega \subset M$ be a bounded domain with connected smooth boundary $\Sigma = \partial\Omega$.

A static extension of $\Omega$ is a complete, asymptotically flat Riemannian 3-manifold $(N,h)$ of nonnegative scalar curvature together with an isometric embedding $\Omega \hookrightarrow N$ such that $N \setminus \Omega$ is a static vacuum manifold, i.e. there exists a positive function $V$ on $N\setminus\Omega$ (tending to $1$ at infinity) satisfying
$$V \mathrm{Ric}(h) = \nabla^2 V, \qquad \Delta V = 0$$
on $N\setminus\Omega$, with matching of the induced metric and mean curvature of $\Sigma$ from the two sides.

(a) Prove that for every such $\Omega \subset M$ there exists a static extension $(N,h)$ as above.

(b) Among all asymptotically flat extensions of $\Omega$ with nonnegative scalar curvature whose exterior region $N\setminus\Omega$ contains no closed minimal surfaces (horizon-free), determine whether the static extension realizes the infimum of the ADM mass.
artifact.status_search_result: Bartnik's static metric extension conjecture remains open in full generality. Substantial partial progress has been made: local well-posedness of the static vacuum extension problem near a Euclidean ball and near general static vacuum metrics (Anderson–Khuri, An, and others, 2003–2025), axisymmetric flow approaches (2019), and recent local well-posedness for the stationary version near Schwarzschild spheres (2025). None of these resolve the global existence and the minimization property of the ADM mass among horizon-free extensions.

status_evidence.title: Existence of static vacuum extensions with prescribed Bartnik boundary data
status_evidence.snippet: Static vacuum extensions are constructed for a large class of Bartnik boundary data, with local well-posedness near Euclidean and general static backgrounds.
status_evidence.claim: Static existence established only locally/perturbatively; global conjecture still open.

status_evidence.title: A flow approach to Bartnik's static metric extension conjecture in axisymmetry
status_evidence.snippet: Geometric flow approach to the conjecture under axisymmetry assumption.

status_evidence.title: Local Well-Posedness for the Bartnik Stationary Extension Problem near Schwarzschild Spheres
status_evidence.snippet: Recent local well-posedness for stationary extensions near Schwarzschild data.
status_evidence.claim: Only local results near specific backgrounds, not the full conjecture.

status_evidence.title: On Existence of Static Metric Extensions in General Relativity
status_evidence.snippet: Early work on the existence of static metric extensions.
status_evidence.claim: Initial partial existence results; minimization aspect not resolved.
